symptom: ALTER PAGE had INSERT/REPLACE/DROP but no MOVE or WRAP, so an existing widget could not be put into a new container; a legacy classic Data grid (unauthorable in MDL) needed a BSON patch outside mxcli after a 9 -> 11 upgrade.
cause: No mutator primitive moved a stored widget subtree; every placement went through serializing MDL-built widgets.
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/move.go (MoveWidget, refuseMoveSource, subtreeHolds); mdl/executor/cmd_alter_page.go (applyWrapWidgetMutator); MDLParser.g4 (alterMove, alterWrap), MDLLexer.g4 (WRAP)
fix: MoveWidget removes the subtree from its parent array and inserts it before/after/into a destination, all checks first; WRAP is INSERT BEFORE of one named container (so it takes the target's data context) followed by MoveWidget INTO it. MCP refuses.
insight: Build the new operation from one primitive plus an existing path: WRAP = the existing INSERT (which already handles entity context, duplicate names and widget kinds) + a byte-preserving MOVE, so only MOVE needed new tree code. Re-find the destination after removing the source: indices in the shared parent array shift. Prove 'not rebuilt' by comparing the moved subtree's bson dump before and after (identical).
test: mdl/backend/pagemutator/move_2122_test.go (into, before/after, refusals leave the tree unchanged; guard stubbed -> self-move accepted), mdl/visitor/alter_page_move_wrap_2122_test.go; live: wrap a grid in a data view, grid subtree byte-identical, mx check 0 errors
